주스.t: Standard spelling is 주스, though you'll often see 쥬스 on signs.

배우.x: That actor is very famous in Korea.
배우.t: Don't confuse with the verb 배우다 (to learn): 배워요 means 'I learn', not 'actor'.

노래.x: Let's sing at a karaoke room.
노래.e: Probably from 놀다 (to play). 노래방 = karaoke room.
노래.t: 'Sing a song' = 노래(를) 하다 or 노래를 부르다.

피다.ex: 봄이 되면 공원에 꽃이 많이 피어요.
피다.x: When spring comes, lots of flowers bloom in the park.
피다.e: Also used for faces: 얼굴이 피다 'to look healthier, to glow'.
피다.t: In speech 피어요 often shortens to 펴요: 꽃이 폈어요 = The flowers have bloomed.

휴일.x: On my day off, I want to get a good rest at home.
휴일.t: 휴일 is any day off; a national holiday on the calendar is 공휴일.

부부.x: The couple next door get along very well.

매달.x: I have to pay rent at the end of every month.
매달.t: 매달 and 매월 mean the same; 매월 sounds more formal.

킬로그램.x: I've lost about 3 kilograms since last month.
킬로그램.e: From English 'kilogram'; in speech often shortened to 킬로.
킬로그램.t: Korea uses the metric system, so body weight is given in kilograms, not pounds.

계좌.x: I opened a new account at the bank.
계좌.e: Literally 'counting place' — where your money is tallied.
계좌.t: 계좌 is the account itself; 통장 is the bankbook, but people often use them interchangeably.

내과.ex: 배가 계속 아프면 내과에 가 보세요.
내과.x: If your stomach keeps hurting, try going to an internal medicine clinic.
내과.e: -과 = medical department: 내과, 외과, 안과, 소아과.
내과.t: Pronounced [내꽈] — 과 in department names is usually tensed.

자원.x: Korea lacks natural resources, so it imports oil.
자원.t: Homonym: 자원 自願 'volunteering,' as in 자원봉사 (volunteer work).

후회.ex: 최선을 다했으니까 이번 일에 후회는 없어요.
후회.x: I did my best, so I have no regrets about this.
후회.t: Common pattern: -(으)ㄴ 것을 후회하다 'to regret having done'.

추천.x: I came to this restaurant on a friend's recommendation.
추천.e: Literally 'push forward and recommend' someone or something.

수출하다.x: Korea exports a lot of cars every year.

고유.x: Hanbok is clothing unique to Korea.
고유.e: Literally 'firmly possessed' — belonging only to that thing.
고유.t: Almost always used as X 고유의 (+noun), 'unique to X'.

한계.x: I felt I'd hit my physical limit, so I took a short break.

레벨.ex: 주말 내내 게임해서 레벨을 많이 올렸어요.
레벨.x: I played games all weekend and leveled up a lot.
레벨.t: 레벨을 올리다 or 레벨 업 하다 = to level up; also for skill: 레벨 테스트 = placement test.

꿀꿀.x: The pigs are oinking as they eat their feed.
꿀꿀.e: 의성어 (sound word) imitating a pig's grunt.
꿀꿀.t: Verb: 꿀꿀거리다 'to oink'. Casual 꿀꿀하다 means 'to feel gloomy': 날씨가 꿀꿀해요.

쫄깃쫄깃.x: This rice cake is really chewy.
쫄깃쫄깃.e: Manner word (의태어) for a springy, elastic texture; a big compliment for 떡, noodles or squid in Korean food.
쫄깃쫄깃.t: Pronounced [쫄긷쫄긷]: final ㅅ sounds like ㄷ. The short adjective 쫄깃하다 is also very common.

그 대신.forms: A. 그 대신 B. · N 대신 (instead of N)
그 대신.ex: 제가 밥을 살게요. 그 대신 커피는 사 주세요.
그 대신.x: I'll buy the meal. In return, you get the coffee.
그 대신.t: Often introduces a trade-off or condition: 싸요. 그 대신 좀 멀어요 'It's cheap, but on the other hand it's a bit far.'

마침.forms: 마침 + clause: 마침 잘됐다 (perfect timing) · 마침 그때
마침.m: just then, just in time, conveniently, as it happens
마침.ex: 마침 잘 오셨어요. 지금 전화하려고 했어요.
마침.x: You came at just the right time. I was about to call you.
마침.e: Native adverb: things happen to fit at the right moment. Different from 마침내 'finally'.
마침.t: Usually for good timing: 마침 잘됐네요! 'Perfect timing!' For bad timing, Koreans say 하필.

관심을 끌다.forms: 관심을 끌어요 · 끌었어요 · 끌 거예요 · 관심을 끄는 (+noun) (ㄹ drops)
관심을 끌다.m: to attract interest, to draw attention
관심을 끌다.ex: 새로운 스마트폰이 소비자들의 관심을 끌고 있어요.
관심을 끌다.x: The new smartphone is drawing consumers' interest.
관심을 끌다.e: 끌다 means 'to pull': pulling people's interest toward you.
관심을 끌다.t: 관심을 끌다 focuses on the thing doing the attracting; 관심을 받다 focuses on receiving the attention.

조연.x: He was a supporting actor, but his acting was really impressive.

출간.ex: 그 작가의 새 소설이 다음 달에 출간돼요.
출간.x: The author's new novel comes out next month.
출간.t: 출간 focuses on a particular book coming out; 출판 also covers the publishing business in general.

알고리즘.ex: 유튜브 알고리즘이 제가 좋아할 만한 영상을 추천해 줘요.
알고리즘.x: YouTube's algorithm recommends videos I'm likely to enjoy.
알고리즘.e: From English 'algorithm'; note the ending 즘, not 듬.
알고리즘.t: 알고리즘에 뜨다 means 'to show up in your recommended feed'.

서버.x: There were too many applicants, so the server went down.
서버.e: From English 'server'; only the computer sense, not a waiter.

끼어들다.forms: 끼어들어요 · 끼어들었어요 · 끼어들 거예요 · 끼어드세요 (ㄹ drops)
끼어들다.m: to cut in, to butt in, to interrupt; to merge (into traffic)
끼어들다.x: Don't butt into other people's conversations.

쓰러지다.m: to fall down, collapse; to go under (a business)
쓰러지다.ex: 어젯밤 강한 바람에 큰 나무가 쓰러졌어요.
쓰러지다.x: A big tree fell over in the strong wind last night.
쓰러지다.t: For people, 쓰러지다 often means collapsing from illness or exhaustion, not just tripping (넘어지다).

대가.x: I had to pay the price for my mistake.
대가.t: Pronounced [대까]; without tensing, 대가 means 'great master', as in 음악의 대가.

한도.ex: 이 카드는 한 달 사용 한도가 백만 원이에요.
한도.x: This card has a monthly spending limit of one million won.
한도.t: 한도 is a set amount, like a card limit; 한계 is the limit of what you can do.

해장국.ex: 술 마신 다음 날 아침에는 해장국을 먹어요.
해장국.x: The morning after drinking, I have hangover soup.
해장국.e: 해장 'easing a hangover' (from older 해정 解酲) + 국 'soup'.
해장국.t: Pronounced [해장꾹]. 해장하다 means 'to cure a hangover', usually with a hot soup.

파면.x: The Constitutional Court decided to remove the president from office.
파면.e: Literally 'stopping and releasing' someone from office.

위헌.x: The Constitutional Court ruled that the law was unconstitutional.

논설.x: This newspaper's editorials are always sharp.

보물.ex: 이 절에는 보물로 지정된 탑이 있어요.
보물.x: This temple has a pagoda designated as a national Treasure.
보물.t: In Korea's heritage system, 국보 (National Treasure) ranks above 보물 (Treasure).

회담.ex: 두 나라는 평화를 위한 회담을 열었습니다.
회담.x: The two countries held talks for peace.

탄소.ex: 자동차를 덜 타면 탄소 배출을 줄일 수 있어요.
탄소.x: If we drive less, we can reduce carbon emissions.
탄소.e: Literally 'charcoal element'. -소 marks elements: 산소, 수소, 질소.

보류하다.m: to put on hold, to defer, to shelve
보류하다.ex: 회사는 신제품 출시를 당분간 보류하기로 했습니다.
보류하다.x: The company decided to put the new product launch on hold for now.
보류하다.e: Literally 'keep and hold back' — setting something aside for later.
보류하다.t: 보류 is the everyday word for shelving plans; 유보 sounds more formal, as in 판단을 유보하다.

경이롭다.x: The power of nature is truly amazing.

유별나다.m: unusual, peculiar; fussy, over the top
유별나다.ex: 그 친구는 음식에 대해 좀 유별난 편이에요.
유별나다.x: That friend is a bit fussy about food.
유별나다.e: 유별 'having a difference' + 나다 'to stand out'.
유별나다.t: Pronounced [유별라다] — ㄴ after ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

우둔하다.ex: 그는 겉보기엔 우둔해 보여도 사실은 아주 영리해요.
우둔하다.x: He may look slow-witted, but he's actually very clever.

성심껏.m: wholeheartedly, sincerely, with all one's heart
성심껏.x: We will sincerely do our best to answer your questions.
성심껏.e: Literally 'to the full of a sincere heart'.

칠전팔기.m: never giving up; falling seven times and rising eight
칠전팔기.x: After failing again and again without giving up, he passed the exam.
칠전팔기.e: Literally 'fall seven times, get up eight'.
칠전팔기.t: The 오뚝이 toy, which always pops back up, is its classic symbol.

회복력.x: Children tend to recover faster than adults.
회복력.e: Literally 'power to return to the original state'.
회복력.t: Pronounced [회봉녁] — ㄱ becomes ㅇ and ㄹ becomes ㄴ through nasalization.

멘털.ex: 그 선수는 멘털이 강해서 실수해도 금방 회복해요.
멘털.x: That athlete is mentally tough, so he recovers quickly even after a mistake.
멘털.e: From English 'mental', used as a noun meaning mindset, a Konglish twist. Often spelled 멘탈.
멘털.t: 멘털이 강하다/약하다 means mentally tough/fragile; the slang 멘붕 is short for 멘털 붕괴.

외래.ex: 오늘은 입원하지 않고 외래로 진료를 받았어요.
외래.x: I wasn't admitted today; I was seen as an outpatient.
외래.e: Literally 'coming from outside': patients who come in and go home.
외래.t: Often used as 외래 진료 (outpatient care) or 외래 환자 (outpatient); also appears in 외래어, 'loanword'.

안절부절.forms: 안절부절못하다 (to be restless); 안절부절 어쩔 줄 모르다
안절부절.m: restlessly, fidgeting, on pins and needles
안절부절.ex: 그는 면접 결과를 기다리며 하루 종일 안절부절못했어요.
안절부절.x: He was on pins and needles all day waiting for the interview results.
안절부절.e: A native mimetic word picturing someone unable to sit still.
안절부절.t: The standard verb is 안절부절못하다, written as one word; 안절부절하다 is considered incorrect.

애도하다.m: to mourn, to grieve, to express condolences
애도하다.ex: 온 국민이 그의 죽음을 깊이 애도했습니다.
애도하다.x: The whole nation deeply mourned his death.
애도하다.t: 삼가 고인의 명복을 빕니다 and 애도를 표합니다 are formal ways to express condolences.

불씨.m: ember, spark; seed (of conflict or trouble)
불씨.x: A small misunderstanding became the spark of the conflict.
불씨.e: 불 'fire' + 씨 'seed': a fire seed, like an ember kept alive to start a new fire.
불씨.t: It can be positive too: 희망의 불씨 means 'a glimmer of hope' that is still alive.

환호.x: When the players came out, the crowd burst into cheers.
환호.t: Typical patterns: 환호가 터지다 (cheers erupt) and 환호를 받다 (be cheered).

미수.ex: 그는 살인 미수 혐의로 경찰에 체포되었습니다.
미수.x: He was arrested by police on charges of attempted murder.
미수.e: Literally 'not yet accomplished' — a crime tried but not completed.
미수.t: It goes after the crime name: 살인 미수 'attempted murder', 강도 미수 'attempted robbery'.
rel: to end as a mere attempt

재화.x: All kinds of goods and services are traded in the market.
재화.e: Literally 'wealth and goods'; paired with 용역 'services' in economics.

패권주의.ex: 많은 나라가 강대국의 패권주의를 비판하고 있어요.
패권주의.x: Many countries criticize the hegemonism of the great powers.

초강대국.ex: 냉전 시대에는 두 초강대국이 세계를 나누어 지배했어요.
초강대국.x: During the Cold War, two superpowers divided and dominated the world.

내정간섭.ex: 그 나라는 외국의 비판을 내정간섭이라고 반발했어요.
내정간섭.x: That country pushed back, calling the foreign criticism interference in its internal affairs.
내정간섭.t: 간섭 is everyday too: 간섭하지 마세요 means 'Stop meddling'.

보편주의.ex: 보편주의는 모든 인간에게 같은 권리가 있다고 주장해요.
보편주의.x: Universalism claims that all humans have the same rights.

시비.ex: 법원은 이번 사건의 시비를 가려야 합니다.
시비.x: The court must determine who is right and who is wrong in this case.
시비.e: Literally 'right-wrong'; 시비를 가리다 = to sort out who is right.
시비.t: In everyday speech, 시비를 걸다 means 'to pick a quarrel': 왜 시비를 걸어요?

무위자연.m: non-action and naturalness (Taoist ideal); living naturally without striving
무위자연.ex: 그는 은퇴 후 시골에서 무위자연의 삶을 살고 있어요.
무위자연.x: After retiring, he is living a simple, natural life in the countryside.
무위자연.e: Literally 'without forced action, as things naturally are'.

인의예지.m: benevolence, righteousness, propriety and wisdom (the four Confucian virtues)
인의예지.ex: 옛 선비들은 인의예지를 가장 중요한 덕목으로 여겼어요.
인의예지.x: Classical scholars regarded the four virtues as the most important.
인의예지.e: Four virtues in one word; Seoul's gates 흥인지문, 돈의문, 숭례문 use three of them.
인의예지.t: Pronounced [이늬예지]; in casual speech the 의 often sounds like [이].

적자생존.ex: 적자생존은 환경에 잘 적응한 생물이 살아남는다는 뜻입니다.
적자생존.x: Survival of the fittest means organisms well adapted to their environment survive.
적자생존.e: Literally 'the fit one survives'. -자 = person or one who: 적자, 과학자.
적자생존.t: Pronounced [적짜생존]; also note 적자 alone usually means 'deficit' — a different word.

내적 갈등.forms: 내적 갈등을 겪다 · 내적 갈등에 빠지다
내적 갈등.ex: 주인공은 사랑과 의무 사이에서 내적 갈등을 겪어요.
내적 갈등.x: The main character goes through an internal conflict between love and duty.
내적 갈등.e: Literally 'inner conflict' — a struggle inside a character's mind.
내적 갈등.t: Pronounced [내쩍 갈뜽]; the usual verb is 겪다 'to go through'.

사화.ex: 연산군 때 일어난 사화로 많은 선비가 죽었어요.
사화.x: Many scholars died in the literati purges under Yeonsangun.
사화.e: Literally 'disaster for scholars'; Joseon saw four major purges.

철두철미.m: thoroughness, being thorough from start to finish
철두철미.ex: 그는 일을 할 때 항상 철두철미하게 준비합니다.
철두철미.x: He always prepares thoroughly when he works.
철두철미.e: Literally 'thorough at the head, thorough at the tail' — complete from start to finish.
철두철미.t: Mostly used as 철두철미하다 or 철두철미하게 to praise careful, flawless work.

제고하다.m: to raise, to enhance, to improve (efficiency, awareness)
제고하다.ex: 정부는 국가 경쟁력을 제고하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
제고하다.x: The government is working to enhance national competitiveness.
제고하다.t: Don't confuse with 재고하다 (to reconsider) — they sound almost the same.

진단하다.x: The doctor diagnosed his illness as gastritis.
진단하다.t: Also figurative: experts 경제 상황을 진단하다 'assess the economic situation'.

늠름하다.ex: 군복을 입은 아들의 모습이 정말 늠름했어요.
늠름하다.x: My son looked truly dignified in his military uniform.
늠름하다.e: A doubled syllable for emphasis — 'imposing, imposing'.
늠름하다.t: Pronounced [늠늠하다] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅁ; often used for boys, men or soldiers.

무수하다.x: Countless stars are shining in the night sky.

푸근하다.ex: 할머니 집에 가면 언제나 마음이 푸근해져요.
푸근하다.x: Whenever I go to my grandma's house, I feel warm and at ease.
푸근하다.e: Works for weather, blankets and people: soft, mild and comforting.

기후위기.ex: 기후위기에 대응하려면 모든 나라가 함께 노력해야 합니다.
기후위기.x: To respond to the climate crisis, every country must work together.

엄단하다.m: to punish severely, to deal strictly with
엄단하다.x: The government announced it would crack down hard on drunk driving.

에두르다.forms: 에둘러요 · 에둘렀어요 · 에두를 거예요 · 에두르세요 (르 irregular)
에두르다.m: to go around, to surround; to beat around the bush, to say indirectly
에두르다.e: Related to 두르다 'to wrap around' and 에우다 'to go around' — talking around the point.
에두르다.t: Mostly 에둘러 말하다/표현하다 'to say in a roundabout way'; the opposite is 직설적으로 'bluntly'.

천편일률.ex: 요즘 드라마는 내용이 너무 천편일률적이라 재미가 없어요.
천편일률.x: Dramas these days are so formulaic that they're boring.
천편일률.e: Literally 'a thousand poems in one pattern.'
천편일률.t: Pronounced [천펴닐률]; very often used as 천편일률적 'stereotyped.'

부검.ex: 정확한 사망 원인을 밝히기 위해 부검을 실시했습니다.
부검.x: An autopsy was performed to determine the exact cause of death.
